assets.scope: Standee batch 3 (13 ids). Second artwork used only for the upright standee layer at <=48px cells. Identity evidence: the shipped native sprite and the shipped flat token, both pinned below; the game was not launched for this round. Flat 128px token, its master and the manifest mapping are untouched. Reused dragon-family composition: rearing on the hind legs with the chest lifted, the wings folded tight or held in a narrow vertical V, never spread wide, and the tail curled close; the on-screen body height may land around 1.2-1.75 cells because of the 1.0-cell width cap, which is accepted.
assets.gate_reason: The shipped flat 128px cut-out is a near-square top-down token; at the 1.0-cell standee width cap it is width-bound and renders about one cell tall, reading as the flat token rather than an upright standee. A full-body upright standee is required for the standee layer only; the flat token, its master and the manifest mapping are unchanged.
assets.desc: This ancient Treant's bark is scorched almost black. It sees humanity as a scourge, to be purged.

references.note: The shipped flat Snaproot token: copy its matte painted miniature finish, colours, value structure and identity. Ignore its top-down camera and its physical disc entirely - the standee has no disc.
Native Snaproot sprite: identity cue only. Keep the same species, colour pattern and markings, converted to a true upright composition; it is not a pose or proportion specification.

The shipped treant token is the sibling tree this one must stay clearly distinct from: it has a straight brown trunk and a compact dark-GREEN leafy crown; the shipped wrathroot is a bent grey willow with a long pale drooping frond curtain. Snaproot has NO leaves, only charcoal-blackened bare branches.

assets.render_evidence_note: No fixture run. Identity-render evidence is the pinned native sprite PNG and the shipped flat token PNG; the desc line in the pinned native NPC source is the appearance authority.

prompt_fields.subject: Snaproot: an ancient scorched Treant whose bark is burned ALMOST BLACK, a thick charred trunk with a heavy knotted bark face and deep hollow eyes, BARE blackened branch arms with NO green leaves at all, a narrow crown of dry dead branch-tips, and thick charred root-feet splayed at the base with faint pale ash cracks between the blackened plates. Match the shipped flat token's near-black charred bark with pale cracks.
prompt_fields.contrast: Tall and narrow: the charred trunk rises straight, the bare dead branches stay close to the body and the root-feet stay under the trunk, so the silhouette stays about 1.5 to 1.8 tall to wide. It differs from the shipped treant (a healthy straight brown trunk with a compact dark-GREEN leafy crown) and from wrathroot (a bent grey willow with a long pale drooping frond curtain); Snaproot has NO leaves, only bare blackened scorched branches. No fire, embers, smoke or green foliage.
prompt_fields.composition: Full body, upright standing three-quarter view, the charred trunk with the bark face forward, bare blackened branch arms held close, root-feet planted at the bottom, the dry dead crown at the top of the frame. Overall height about 1.6 to 1.8 times the width; nothing above the crown.
prompt_fields.palette: near-black charred bark with cool grey highlights, faint pale ash-grey cracks, dull ember-brown under-tones deep in the crevices, dark hollow eyes; no green.
